title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open multimodal mixture-of-experts model
excerpt: The 816B parameter model supports text, image, audio, and video inputs for agentic coding tasks.
bodyHtml:
Hugging Face announced on October 15, 2026, the release of Muse Spark Open, an open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model developed by Meta. The model features approximately 816 billion total parameters, with 42 billion active parameters per token.

The model is designed for agentic coding tasks such as reading codebases, debugging, and tool calling. It supports text, image, audio, and video inputs and provides a context window of up to 1 million tokens.

The model architecture utilizes 256 experts per layer, with a router selecting 8 experts for each token. It is available in BF16 and NVFP4 checkpoint formats, with the latter designed for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. Users can deploy the model via integrations including llama.cpp, SGLang, and vLLM.
